title: Genymotion VM surface-render timeout blocks the device Challenge gate (NOT a code defect)
summary: C00 + C01 device Challenges FAIL on the freshly-booted Genymotion Pixel 9 / API35 VM with 'No compose hierarchies found'. Root-caused to the VM's window-surface rendering timing out, NOT a Lava code regression.

evidence.app_launches_clean: MainActivity PRE_ON_CREATE -> CREATED -> STARTED -> RESUMED (fully visible); FirebaseCrashlytics init OK; NO FATAL, NO crash, NO nav-graph IllegalArgumentException, NO compose exception from the app process.
surface_render_failure: W SurfaceComposerClient: Sync transaction timed out waiting for commit callback
E BufferQueueProducer: [VRI[InstrumentationActivityInvoker$EmptyActivity]] allocateBuffers: failed to allocate buffer (0 x 0, format 1, usage 0xb00)
evidence.test_failure_site: androidx.compose.ui.test.AndroidComposeUiTestEnvironment.withWindowRecomposer (ComposeUiTest.android.kt:413) -> 'No compose hierarchies found' (the window-recomposer found no composition attached to a committed surface).
code_exoneration: LVA-008 NavTeardownCrashReporter.install isolation test: C00 FAILS even with the install DISABLED -> LVA-008 is NOT the cause.
LVA-052 topic route added NavigationArgument(ProviderIdKey, nullable=true) as an OPTIONAL arg (?p=...) with existing openTopic(id) call sites unchanged; NO nav-graph build exception in logcat.
evidence.prior_pass: 2026-06-08 gate-coreflows on a Genymotion Pixel 9 had C00 + C01 + C07 + C08 PASS (only C06 FAILED) -> a properly-rendering Genymotion VM passes these; the regression is the VM render state, not Lava code.

remediation: Environment-side: the Genymotion VM needs a working GPU/display render surface. Candidate fixes (PENDING_FORENSICS — confirm on a re-render): ensure the VM screen is unlocked/on; enable hardware OpenGL in the Genymotion VM settings (Use virtual hardware GPU); or restart the VM with display/GPU acceleration. Then re-run scripts/run-genymotion-challenges.sh.
distribute_impact: Per §6.Z the Firebase re-distribute stays BLOCKED on a GREEN device gate. A distribute on a red gate is the exact §6.Z bluff (cf. 1.2.19-1039); NOT performed.
resolution: RESOLVED 2026-06-09: the Genymotion VM screen was asleep, idling the render pipeline (surface-commit timeout). Waking it (adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP + svc power stayon true) restored rendering. C01 then PASSED; the full core-flow gate C00+C01+C07+C08 PASSED (evidence .lava-ci-evidence/genymotion/coreflow-gate-20260609T160325Z). NOT a code defect. The runner SHOULD wake+stay-on the screen before connectedDebugAndroidTest (follow-up: add the keyevent to scripts/run-genymotion-challenges.sh).
